decisions.reason: The battery-interface impact is already fully represented by its message-77 MODIFY, including the new rear placement and removal of the obsolete connector-gap requirement.
The USB-C connector is only a positional reference; its type, data lines, and sourceability requirements remain unchanged.
Changing the battery connector placement does not alter the charge-status indicator, GPIO, or separate-LED requirement.
The mechanical relocation of the battery connector does not change any battery-protection mode or cutoff behavior.
The source decision changes connector placement only and does not alter the requirement for battery NTC sensing through J_BAT.
The battery connector relocation does not affect boost-converter enable control, pull-down resistance, or powered-load behavior.
No change to TVS-based ESD protection is entailed by the connector-placement decision.
The source decision does not affect I2C cable length, clock speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
The source changes only physical placement and makes no component-selection or availability decision.
